name: Raw | Pre-Rolled Tips
description: RAW Pre-rolled Tips are made from the purest natural fibres, all of which are chlorine free and vegan friendly. The RAW Pre-Rolled Tips box contains 20 pre-rolled tips in a great matchbox style packaging, which makes sure that your tips never get crushed.
